title: Revert Version 21 Callaway scoring change causing incorrect calculations

requirements.text: Undo the Version 21 backend scoring change by fixing `backend/main.mo` so Callaway deductions are computed from the worst (highest) hole scores, including correct handling of fractional (0.5) holes.

quotes: this is not calculating correctly undo this change

acceptanceCriteria: For a non-fractional deductionHoles value (e.g., 3.0), the backend sums the 3 highest hole scores (worst holes), not the 3 lowest.
For a fractional deductionHoles value (e.g., 3.5), the backend sums the 3 highest hole scores plus half of the next-highest hole score using a documented, consistent rounding rule.
The half-hole calculation uses the same sorted ordering as the full-hole calculation (i.e., it takes the next worst score, not an arbitrary unsorted score).
Net score calculation remains: if gross <= par then net = gross, else net = gross - deduction + adjustment.

requirements.text: Undo the Version 21 backend chart change by reverting the hard-coded `chart` data in `backend/main.mo` to the last known-correct production chart (removing placeholder rows/ranges that lead to incorrect lookups), and ensure `getCallawayChart()` returns the reverted chart exactly as used by backend calculations.

quotes: this is not calculating correctly undo this change

acceptanceCriteria: The backend no longer contains placeholder chart rows/ranges that can match real gross scores with 0 deduction/0 adjustment unexpectedly.
`getCallawayChart()` returns the same chart values/ranges that `calculateCallaway()` uses for lookup (no divergence).
For gross scores above the highest defined range, lookup behavior is correct and deterministic (e.g., an open-ended last band or equivalent), matching the reverted chart semantics.

requirements.text: Add a small, deterministic backend-level verification (unit-style logic or debug-only checks) to confirm that backend deduction/net calculations match the frontend’s intended behavior for representative sample scorecards (including fractional and non-fractional deduction cases).

quotes: this is not calculating correctly undo this change

acceptanceCriteria: There is at least one verification covering a case where deductionHoles is an integer (e.g., 1.0, 3.0).
There is at least one verification covering a case where deductionHoles has a 0.5 fraction (e.g., 0.5, 2.5, 3.5).
Verification explicitly demonstrates that worst holes are the highest hole scores.

constraints: Backend must remain a single Motoko actor in `backend/main.mo` (no additional backend services).
Do not modify any files under `frontend/src/components/ui` or other frontend immutable paths listed in SYSTEM_CONTEXT.
nonGoals: Do not add new product features or new scoring systems beyond reverting/fixing the incorrect calculation change.
Do not redesign the UI/UX; this request is specifically about correcting/reverting scoring calculations.
